_definitions.I0:
SL5i-G I0 — run identity (CPU, read-only).

Per run (pb5 = SL5g reference, pb6 / pb7 = SL5i-G): commit, dirty, source_diff_sha256 (sha256 of an empty diff =
e3b0c442...), untracked_sha256, algorithm_trees, settings.ag3s_version / panda_conversion_mode, the server argv (flags
after '--robot panda' = profile flags), presence of --grasp-reach-sticky / --grasp-drop-from-open / --closing-hand-exempt,
the server console line 'SafePolicy grasp contact rules' (what apply_grasp_contact_flags reported at start), the
gpu-lock record, conversion.mode of every call, and the presence of the new record keys
(grasp.evidence.reach_sticky, grasp.evidence.drop_from_open, to.grasp_contact.closing_exempt_rows) in every call.
server_argv is compared with the pb5 run of the same set (port value excluded).

VLA-only reuse basis (SL5g vla_only_identity.py approach): `git diff --name-only 38722284 1ddb9376` (code files),
diff hunks of AG3S/trajopt/serve_safe.py located against the `if args.no_safe:` branch of build/serve, unchanged-path
checks for the VLA-only path (policy_seed.py, libero_safe_client.py, third_party/openpi, common, scripts) and the
manifest protocol / runtime_schedule / checkpoint / dependencies of the VLA-only run vs the pb6 / pb7 runs.
Output: outputs/verify/SL5i-G/i0_identity.json
_definitions.I1:
SL5i-G I1 — aggregate + transitions + candidate rules (same definitions as SL5g agg_pairing_rules.py). CPU, read-only.

Per set and version: official / collided / safe_success (SafeLIBERO only) / HOLD (safe_client.hold_calls; episodes with >= 1).
Transitions on the same (task, init, policy seed, obstacle) pair: counts of T->T, T->F, F->T, F->F per metric.
Candidate rules (counted separately, SL5g #1/#2):
  (a) official F->S : VLA-only official False -> version official True
  (b) safe F->T     : VLA-only safe_success False -> version safe_success True (of which VLA-only collided)
  plus regression official T->F, collided -> free, free -> collided.
Output: outputs/verify/SL5i-G/i1_aggregate.json
_definitions.I2:
SL5i-G I2 — were the pb6 / pb7 rules applied, and when does the latch reach HELD (CPU, read-only).

Per version (pb5 = grasp zone 허용판, pb6 = 파지 인식 수정판, pb7 = 파지 인식 + closing 면제판), per episode, from the calls log:
  sticky_used           : calls with grasp.evidence.reach_sticky.used True (reach measured now failed, the pass of this attempt kept it True)
  sticky_used_at_attach : of those, calls that became HELD (state_before != held, state == held)
  drop_open_source      : calls with grasp.evidence.drop_from_open.source == 'last_open' (basis = last open opening)
  drop_changed          : calls with checks.dropped True where the transition basis would fail
                          (drop_from_open.transition_opening - evidence.opening_after < min_drop 0.05)
  drop_changed_at_attach: of those, calls that became HELD
  closing_exempt_calls  : calls with to.grasp_contact.closing_exempt_rows > 0 (rows summed in closing_exempt_rows_sum)
  closing_cond_calls    : CLOSING calls whose evidence.checks closed, not_empty, blocked are all True (pb7 condition)
HELD entries = calls with grasp.state == 'held' and grasp.state_before != 'held'. For each: obs = call_obs_index,
  both = SL5h mj_probe_h track both_fingers[obs] (left and right finger sides touch the target body, dist <= 0),
  rise = target rise at obs (mm, vs obs = wait), lifted = both & rise >= 30 mm.
  false held = HELD entry with both False. 'same as pb5' = pb5 has a HELD entry at the same seq with both False.
first_lifted_obs = MuJoCo first obs (>= wait) with both & rise >= 30 mm (SL5g lift_metrics); first_lifted_call = first call
  whose obs is lifted. held_minus_lift_obs = obs of the first HELD entry - first_lifted_obs.
Action divergence: first env step where episode npz 'action' differs between two versions (state at that obs is shared),
  call = chunk_index of that step in the later version. Replay (outputs/verify/SL5i-pre/replay_table.csv) predicted pb6
  first held seq and first divergence seq are put next to the pb6 run values.
Consistency: contact probe (I5) left & right == mj_probe_h both_fingers for every obs.
Output: outputs/verify/SL5i-G/i2_latch.json
_definitions.I3:
SL5i-G I3 — SL5h signatures per version (vla_only, pb5, pb6, pb7; conversion C) (CPU, .venv-ag3s).

Inputs: outputs/verify/SL5i-G/analysis_<set>.json (SL5h analyze.py unchanged, SL5i-G registry),
        outputs/verify/SL5i-G/calls/*.json, probe/*.json; SL5h summary.py ep_extra (z attribution, policy z sign) imported unchanged.
Signature fields (SL5h definitions, AG3S/ag3s/docs/handoff/SL5h.verify.json numbers._definitions):
  overlift            = episodes with max target rise > 250 mm
  lifted_exec_sat     = lifted env steps with any executed arm component |a| >= 0.999 / lifted env steps (also z >= 0.999)
  Dstar_z_median      = median of Dstar_z = FK_z(refined[k,4]) - FK_z(reference[k,4]) (mm) over lifted calls with conversion clipping
  realised_median     = median realised_frac_obs over the same calls (projection of eef_obs(o+5)-FK(ref[k,4]) on Dstar / |Dstar|^2)
  realised_model      = median conversion.realisation.realised_fraction_median over lifted calls
  closing_rows_up_down= TO-changed rows of closing+lifted optimized calls with FK z change > +0.5 mm / < -0.5 mm
  closing_reach_false = closing+lifted calls with grasp.evidence.checks.reach False / closing+lifted calls
  (same pair for held+lifted rows; all lifted calls with reach False)
Reference rows from SL5h (SL5c A, SL5c B, pb1-B, which lack MI gate / arms / pb4-pb5 rules) are copied from SL5h numbers.json.
Added for SL5i-G (same per-call tables, outputs/verify/SL5i-G/calls/<set>_<v>_<ep>.json written by SL5h analyze.py):
  centroid_after_held = |grasp.tip_alignment.centroid_m (AG3S manipulated centroid, base) - MuJoCo target body (base)| at the
                        call obs (SL5h 'centroid_offset' d3 / dz), over calls at or after the first call with latch 'held' in that
                        episode (all latch states after that point), and over calls with latch 'held' only; also closing+lifted calls.
  closing_lifted_rows_* split by to.grasp_contact.closing_exempt_rows > 0 (pb7) is in res['closing_exempt_split'].
Output: outputs/verify/SL5i-G/i3_signature.json
_definitions.I4:
SL5i-G I4 — SL5g #3 failure-cause classes for VLA-only success -> version failure episodes (CPU, read-only).

Classes (SL5g classify_failures.py / SL5h-G g3_classify.py, first match wins; obs incl. wait; MuJoCo track = SL5h mj_probe_h.py):
  A_no_lift_hold    : never lifted, longest HOLD run >= 5 calls
  A_no_lift_other   : never lifted, longest HOLD run < 5
  B_lifted_lost     : lifted, then >= 10 consecutive obs with no both-finger grasp and rise < 30 mm
  C_lifted_overlift : lifted, not lost, max target rise > 250 mm
  D_lifted_other    : lifted, not lost, max rise <= 250 mm
lifted = both finger sides touch the target body (dist <= 0) and target rise >= 30 mm, obs >= wait.
HOLD run = maximal run of consecutive calls with hold True (SL5g failure_logs.hold_runs, imported unchanged).
Applied to pb5 (cross-checked against SL5g failure_classes.json pb5), pb6, pb7.
Episodes that never reach HELD: failed checks counted over their CLOSING calls (grasp.evidence.checks False), and the
manipulated_id / reach of those calls (I2 tables).
Focus episodes LI t1e2 (pb5 replay: blocked fails 43 calls) and LI t2e0 (latch locked a cluster 400-600 mm from the hand):
per version official / class / first held / closing failed checks / manipulated ids / reach_mm range / opening - command gap.
Output: outputs/verify/SL5i-G/i4_classes.json
_definitions.I5:
SL5i-G I5 — side effects of the closing exemption (CPU, read-only).

Call sets per version (pb5, pb6 = no exemption; pb7 = exemption on):
  cond      : CLOSING calls whose grasp.evidence.checks closed, not_empty, blocked are all True (the pb7 condition; in pb5/pb6
              the same condition holds but nothing is exempted)
  exempt    : pb7 calls with to.grasp_contact.closing_exempt_rows > 0 (rows actually removed)
  split by both = left and right finger sides touch the target at the call obs (I5 contact probe, dist <= 0): O / X.
Window = the 5 executed env steps after the call: observations o+1 .. o+5 (o = call_obs_index), clipped to the episode.
Per call:
  grip_target_win   : any gripper0_* geom touches the target in the window
  robot_other_win   : any robot0_* / gripper0_* geom touches a non-target non-table body in the window (bodies listed;
                      'obstacle' = SafeLIBERO obstacle bodies, name contains 'obstacle')
  target_dxy_mm     : max_j |xy_target(o+j) - xy_target(o)| over the window (target pushed sideways)
  target_dz_mm      : max_j (z_target(o+j) - z_target(o))
  collide_in_win    : SafeLIBERO collide_t (env step) in [o, o+5)
  centroid_target_mm: |AG3S tip_alignment.centroid_m - MuJoCo target (base)| at the call obs (SL5h centroid_offset d3;
                      the manipulated object the exemption refers to vs the task target)
Counts: calls, calls with grip_target_win, robot_other_win (any / obstacle), target_dxy >= 5 / >= 10 mm, collide_in_win,
and the episodes containing them with their official / collided outcome.
Output: outputs/verify/SL5i-G/i5_exempt.json
_definitions.I6:
SL5i-G I6 — case bundles (SL5g / SL5h-G format: case.json, calls_<cond>.csv, frame_<cond>_<label>_obsNNN.png). CPU, read-only.

Case criteria (both sets, new version = pb6 파지 인식 수정판 or pb7 파지 인식 + closing 면제판):
  (a) official F->S         : VLA-only official False -> new version official True
  (b) safe F->T             : VLA-only safe_success False -> new version safe_success True (SafeLIBERO only)
  (c) pb5 over-lift -> new  : pb5 (grasp zone 허용판) official failure with max target rise > 250 mm -> new version official True
Every episode meeting (a), (b) or (c) for pb6 or pb7 gets a bundle outputs/verify/SL5i-G/cases/<set>_<ep>/ with conditions
vla_only, pb5, pb6, pb7.
Key observations (obs index incl. wait):
  div_pb6 / div_pb7 = first env step where executed actions of pb5 and that version differ (state at that obs is shared)
  grasp    = first lifted obs (both fingers on target, rise >= 30 mm), else none
  held     = obs of the first call with grasp.state 'held' (state_before != held)
  maxrise  = obs of max target rise after the wait
  collision= collide_t + 1 when collided
  end      = last obs
Images: agentview raw[::-1] (OpenCV rows), 256 x 256. Videos are referenced by path only.
Output: outputs/verify/SL5i-G/cases/index.json and the bundles.
